verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents defining SLOs and alerting when the SLO budget is threatened. It tracks error budgets through Budget Burndown graphs and sends SLO burn alerts to webhooks and other destinations, and SLOs can also be managed through the API. missing for 10: detailed documentation of burn-rate alert configuration (thresholds, windows, budget-rate vs exhaustion-time modes), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SLO feature.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts

citations.quote: Use Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to define an agreement regarding delivery of a given service and be alerted when your SLO budget is threatened.
Honeycomb will track SLO values past your retention period, but will display these for only the Budget Burndown and Historical Compliance graphs.
Route Honeycomb Trigger and SLO burn alerts to any service that accepts a JSON payload, including third-party tools and custom integrations.
Use variables to customize payloads for your Honeycomb trigger alerts and SLO burn alerts.
